assertions.description: The deliverable report.json is saved in the workspace root
The period field is the requested reporting period (May 2026 as YYYY-MM)
Exactly the reimbursable claims of the period were counted (status approved, category not Meals & Entertainment, at least one exported line)
Grand total equals the sum of the counted claim amounts only (620.00 + 340.00 + 42.10); including the excluded Meals & Entertainment or pending claims would raise it
Per cost center totals cover only counted claims: CC-4471 excludes its Meals & Entertainment claims and CC-5120 excludes its pending-approval claim

Whether the correct rule is 'exclude the Meals & Entertainment category' rather than some other category-level rule (an allow-list of reimbursable categories, a meals cap, or a field not present in the export) cannot be checked: neither the task instruction nor the ExpenseDesk Reports page or export states which categories are reimbursable. Only the numeric consequences of the exclusion are verifiable (A3-A5); the rule itself is a declared gap.
